result:
All 617 tests pass cleanly. Summary of the fixes applied, all in `src/`:

- **`src/components/domain/search/query-syntax.ts`**: extracted the token-parsing core into `extractSearchTokens` (raw kinds, no default applied) so the server can tell "no `kind:` token" apart from "token said issues," while `parseSearchQuery` keeps its old behavior for the dialog's hint line.
- **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`**: removed the illegal "colon rejects the query" throw; the service now parses field tokens itself (only when `advanced_search` is on), lets a present `kind:`/`in:` token override the caller's kinds and a `project:` token override the caller's `projectId`, and otherwise falls back to the caller's own request — forcing issues-only when the flag is off. `indexComment` now takes the issue's `projectId` so comments are scoped like issues. The `search.reindex_requested` handler now covers all three subject kinds and drops archived/missing subjects from the index instead of reinstating them.
- **`src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts`**: passes the issue's `projectId` through to `indexComment` during a full workspace rebuild.
- **`src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts`**: escapes `%`, `_`, and `\` before building the `LIKE` pattern and declares `\` as the escape character, so matching is literal as the ADR requires.
